title: Rotate Array
description: Given an integer array `nums`, rotate the array to the right by `k` steps, where `k` is non-negative.
input_format: First line contains `n` and `k`. Second line contains `n` integers.
output_format: The array elements after right rotation by `k`.
hints: Reduce k using modulo: k = k % n.
Notice that rotating right by k moves the last k elements to the front.
You can also reverse the whole array, reverse the first k, and reverse the rest.
